about.title: Jackson Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Jackson is a small place, home to about 4,649 people, and a loss here tends to ripple through the whole town. Grief comes first. Questions about what happens next can wait a little, but they cannot wait forever, because California gives most families two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim, and less time when a city, county, or state agency may share fault. Public records for 2024 show a single injury collision in Jackson and no traffic deaths, which is worth acknowledging. Still, fatal harm reaches families in many ways: a crash where Route 49 meets Route 88, a fall in a care facility, a missed diagnosis, an unsafe job site. A wrongful death case is a civil action, entirely separate from any criminal charges, and it can recover funeral and burial costs, the income your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm. We link Jackson families with an independent attorney who works on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.title: Clarity on who may file
items.desc: California limits standing to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney in our network can sort out who in your family is eligible before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be brought within two years of the date of death, and claims involving a government entity carry a much shorter clock. Getting connected soon keeps those windows open.

items.title: Losses measured fully, at no upfront cost
items.desc: Recoverable damages go beyond funeral and burial expenses to include lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. Network attorneys work on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My family member died in a crash near the Route 49 and 88 junction in Jackson. Does it matter that a state highway was involved?
items.answer: It can. Route 49 and Route 88 are state highways, and if road design, signage, or maintenance played a part, a claim against a public agency may be possible alongside a claim against a driver. Claims involving a government entity in California have a much shorter filing window than the standard two years, so it is wise to speak with an attorney quickly. The attorney can review the collision report and determine which parties may be responsible.

items.question: The other driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and proceeds separately from any criminal prosecution. The two cases have different goals and different standards of proof, and a civil claim can move forward whether or not charges are filed or a conviction results. An attorney can explain how the timelines might interact in your situation.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything to connect us with an attorney?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm, and we do not charge families for the connection. The independent attorneys in our network handle wrongful death cases on contingency, which means no attorney fee unless there is a recovery. You can ask any questions during the first conversation with no obligation to move forward.
